entities.summary: Magnus Wernblom is a Swedish former professional ice hockey forward who spent most of his active career playing for Modo Hockey in the Swedish Elitserien league, where he holds the franchise scoring record for most all-time goals (276) as well as the second highest franchise record for most games played (723). He also spent a few seasons playing for Skellefteå AIK of the same league, before returning to Modo Hockey in 2007. He announced his retirement from hockey on 4 November 2008. Magnus Wernblom is an icon and a cult figure in Modo Hockey.
